source_text: Overall, peer-reviewed consensus emphasizes that purported benefits lack rigorous support, often serving to medicalize cultural practices amid documented harms, with attempts to frame mild forms (e.g., ritual nicks) as low-risk overlooking ethical issues of non-consensual alteration and inconsistent standards compared to intact genitalia preservation.
